subject: AI & Agents
title: System Prompts: Setting the Stage
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: System Prompts: Setting the Stage.

hook.text: Behind every chatbot persona is a hidden instruction telling it exactly how to behave.

buildup.text: System prompts are instructions set by developers that users don't see.

discovery.text: They define personality, tone, boundaries, and capabilities for the entire conversation.

twist.text: Users can sometimes override system prompts with creative phrasing — a constant security challenge.

climax.text: Companies guard their system prompts like trade secrets. They shape the entire user experience.

punchline.text: The most important prompt is the one you never see.

quiz.question: What is a system prompt?
options: Hidden developer instructions that shape the AI's behavior
The first message a user sends
An error message from the system

details.summary: System prompts are hidden instructions that define an LLM's persona, rules, and behavior before a user interacts with it. They shape how the model responds, what it refuses, and what personality it presents.
details.whyItMatters: System prompts are how developers control AI assistants. They determine whether a model is helpful or guarded, creative or precise, and what boundaries it observes during conversation.
takeaways: System prompts set the model's persona, rules, and behavior
They are provided by developers, not visible to end users
They control tone, boundaries, and capabilities of AI assistants

faq.question: Can system prompts be overridden by users?
faq.answer: Users sometimes succeed in getting models to ignore system prompts through creative prompting. This is called prompt injection. Better models are increasingly resistant, but no system prompt is perfectly unbreakable.

faq.question: What makes a good system prompt?
faq.answer: Clear, specific instructions about desired behavior, explicit boundaries for what the model should refuse, example interactions, and output format requirements. Good system prompts are tested and iterated extensively.
